title: Page 9
content_zh:
她的身子晃了一下，然后将视线转向他。
「我知道了……」
是苏劲沧并不急着跟她谈。
在商场上打滚多年，他深谙谈判的技巧，知道当对手处于劣势、有求于他时，他尽可以拖延时间，让对方更急切，那么他就可以获得最大的利益。这招在对付商场上的敌人时战无不克，他更深信拿来对付她是绰绰有余。
他放她几天假，让她找不到他，让她这几天在焦虑当中恐惧，再次见面时，她就会屈服于他提出的任何条件。
到时他会叫她跟儿子一起回家住、再嫁给他，而且不准再离开他身边。她没有其他选择，因为不这样做的话，她就得跟儿子分开。
苏劲沧带着愉悦的心情停好车，走进小兔咖啡屋。
晚餐时间，小兔咖啡屋里除了几个客人，就只剩叶咏欢跟她的房东兼朋友乔若曦，还有一个他看了就皱眉的讨厌人物——陈启铭，好妈妈家事服务的老板。他在这里干什么？
只见那个不起眼的男人正跟她说什么，她一脸认真的凝神细听，甚至连他进来都没有发现，这情况令苏劲沧感觉不快。
「咳。」他走到她身边。
像被吓了一跳般，她惊惶的眨眼。
一定要每次见到他就像见鬼吗？苏劲沧的表情更加阴沉了。
「你说要找我谈？」他连看也不看一旁的陈启铭。
「是……我前几天打电话到你家和公司，都没能跟你说到话……」
「我很忙，秘书留话给我，说你找我。」
「是的，有关小佟的事，我得跟你谈谈。」她突然弯起嘴角，那是一种有自信的笑容。
苏劲沧不确定自己喜欢那样的笑容，直觉告诉他有什么不对劲。
「你今天来正好……」她看了眼对面的陈启铭，像是寻求某种助力，然后她鼓起勇气，转头对他说：「我决定跟你争取小佟的监护权，要上法院还是怎样都无所谓，我不会放弃小佟的。」
这不是他期望中的答案，苏劲沧眯起眼。
「那天律师跟你讲清楚了，不是吗？以你的条件，争取到监护权的可能并不大。」

「可是如果我的条件改变了呢？」她直视他。「陈老板向我求婚，他说会把小佟当成亲生儿子一样疼爱，他说这样我有了一个正常的家庭，比起单身的你就更有优势了。」
他像是挨了一记直拳，而且是在完全没有心理准备的情况之下。
他震惊的张大嘴巴，然后唇角扭曲起来。他看见她戴在左手无名指上的戒指，那是他以前没见过的，也就是说……是那个男人给她的订婚戒指？！
心口被狂怒的风暴所袭击，他用力一拍桌子，那气势把所有人都吓呆了。
「你给我过来！」被那样狂怒的嗓音一吼，她不由得僵住。
他不待她反应就把她扯离座位，抓住她的手把戒指拔下来，愤怒的砸在陈启铭的身上。他瞪了他一眼，那凌厉如刀的视线让陈启铭背脊直发凉，当然也不敢阻拦了。
他把她拖出咖啡屋，直接塞进车里。
叶咏欢这时候才回神，试着扯回自己的手。「你、你干什么？你怎么可以这样？陈老板给我的戒指……」
「闭嘴！不准你再说什么戒指！」
她竟敢收别的男人的戒指？！她竟然想要跟别的男人结婚？！想到自己如果今天没有来，搞不好这个笨女人隔天就变成别人的，他吓出一身冷汗。
除了懊恼自己的弄巧成拙，他更气的是她居然傻傻的就被别人牵着鼻子走。
不行了，他感觉自己已经到极限了，他不能够容忍一丁点失去她的可能。
苏劲沧烦躁的爬了爬头发，他承认，自己载了。
「你别再那里自作主张、胡思乱想了。算了，我娶你，这样你跟儿子不会分开，以后你就乖乖在家带小孩。」
叶咏欢惊讶的眨眼，然后像是突然领悟到他话中的意义，微微的颤抖起来。
「不、不要……我绝对不要跟你结婚。」
苏劲沧的脸全黑了。
她拒绝得那么快、没有犹豫。她是怎样？宁可选择哪个快秃头的中年男人也不选他？
这口气叫他怎么咽得下去？！
「你、你、你……」他快气炸了饿，从紧咬的牙关里勉强迸出最后的威胁。「反正我决定了算，从现在起你跟儿子就搬进我家！」

这是绑架！
叶咏欢愁眉苦脸的坐在庭院里，看着儿子开心的到处玩。对小佟而言，这是个很棒的环境，有一整套的秋千、沙坑、城堡，那都是他爸爸命人在三天之内建造完成的。
他在这里很快乐，有妈妈一整天陪他，有专属的玩具间，还有个占地几十坪的户外游乐场。可是相对的，她却怎么也开心不起来。
她没有办法跟他在一起。
她忘不了他提议要她嫁他时，那施舍的语气。
虽然被她拒绝时他很生气，不过她想，那是因为他的自尊受到伤害，而不是因为她的拒绝。她无法跟他说她之所以不想跟他结婚，不是她已经不再爱他了，相反的，她依然还爱他，很在乎、很在乎他，在乎到他的一举一动都牵动着她所有的情绪——这正是她所害怕的。
她不要了，不要再像个乞丐乞讨他的爱。
她受够了，受够一段貌合神离的婚姻。
那种就在身边，可却又清楚的知道永远得不到的痛苦……她尝够了，也受够了。
「马麻……」玩得满身大汗的小佟摇摇晃晃的走到她身边，抱住她的腿，也打断她的思绪。
她用毛巾帮他把身上的汗擦干。
「把拔呢？把拔……」
儿子天真的话语带给她复杂的感触。才没几天他就跟爸爸好得不得了，是父子天性还是他们的气质真的很相近，她不知道，可是从儿子身上，她清楚的看到他的影子。
当儿子仰起脸，用她从小就疯狂迷恋上的那张脸问她「把拔呢？」时，她真的有种深深的无力感……
「把拔还在上班。」
小佟噘起嘴，似乎不满意这样的回答。
连跋扈的神情都一模一样，她不由得苦笑。
「我们去洗澡吧？洗完澡、睡个觉，可能把拔就回来了。」她只好安抚他。
「好吧！」
得到儿子的「恩准」，她把他带上楼去，替他洗了澡，顺便自己也洗了，然后模子俩就躺在主卧室的大床上，吹着冷气睡着了。

苏劲沧回家看到的就是这个画面——他的女人跟他的儿子甜甜的睡着。一股暖暖的感觉涨满他的胸口，让他严肃的嘴角柔和许多。
他感觉到圆满，一直以来的空虚似乎也得到了填补。
她怀抱着孩子睡着了，睡着的她也像个孩子一样，长长的睫毛像两把浓密的扇子，在雪白的肌肤上印下两排阴影，鲜艳欲滴的嘴唇微张，浴袍因为儿子的关系微微敞开，露出浑圆的曲线。
是生产的关系吗？她的身材似乎比他记忆中更丰腴。
他突然一阵口干舌燥，下腹传来熟悉的骚动。他发现熟睡的她就像是发出浓郁香味的花朵一样强烈诱惑着他。
他伸出指尖碰触那吸引他的粉嫩唇瓣，她怕痒的缩了缩肩膀，那模样可爱得让他很想把她拥进怀中。
叶咏欢张开眼睛，看见他，木然发觉两人的距离很近，她往后退缩，抱起儿子，从床上爬起来。
「对、对不起，在你床上睡着了。刚刚帮小佟洗澡，你知道他喜欢你房间的浴室……」
她慌忙的解释，那刻意表现的疏远、客气，都让他的胸口火烫烫的疼。
content_en:
She swayed for a moment, then turned her gaze to him.
"I see..."
But Su Jincang was not in a hurry to talk to her.
Having been in the business for many years, he is well versed in negotiation skills. He knows that when his opponent is at a disadvantage and wants something from him, he can delay time and make the other party more eager, so that he can obtain the maximum benefit. This technique was invincible against enemies in the mall, and he was even more convinced that it was more than enough to deal with her.
He gave her a few days off so that she could not find him, making her anxious and fearful these days. When they met again, she would succumb to any conditions he proposed.
At that time, he will ask her to go home with his son, marry him again, and she will not be allowed to leave his side again. She had no other choice because otherwise she would have to be separated from her son.
Su Jincang parked the car and walked into the Little Rabbit Cafe with a happy mood.
At dinner time, apart from a few customers at Little Rabbit Cafe, the only ones left were Ye Yonghuan, her landlord and friend Qiao Ruoxi, and an annoying person who made him frown at the sight of them - Chen Qiming, the owner of Good Mom Housework Service. What is he doing here?
She saw what the inconspicuous man was saying to her, and she was listening attentively with a serious look on her face. She didn't even notice that he came in. This situation made Su Jincang feel unhappy.
"Ahem." He walked over to her.
She blinked in panic as if she was startled.
Does it have to be like seeing a ghost every time you see him? Su Jincang's expression became even more gloomy.
"You said you wanted to talk to me?" He didn't even look at Chen Qiming who was standing aside.
"Yes... I called your home and company a few days ago, but I couldn't even talk to you..."
"I'm very busy. My secretary left me a message, asking you to find me."
"Yes, I have to talk to you about Xiao Tong." She suddenly curved her mouth with a confident smile.
Su Jincang wasn't sure he liked that smile, and his intuition told him something was wrong.
"It's just the right time for you to come today..." She glanced at Chen Qiming opposite, as if seeking some kind of help. Then she mustered up the courage and turned to him and said, "I have decided to fight for the custody of Xiao Tong with you. It doesn't matter whether I go to court or not. I will not give up on Xiao Tong."
This was not the answer he expected, Su Jincang narrowed his eyes.
"The lawyer made it clear to you that day, didn't he? With your conditions, it's not very likely to win custody."
"But what if my conditions change?" She looked directly at him. "Boss Chen proposed to me. He said that he would love Xiao Tong as his own son. He said that if I have a normal family, I will have more advantages than you who are single."
It was as if he had received a straight punch, and he was completely unprepared.
He opened his mouth wide in shock, and then the corners of his lips twisted. He saw the ring she wore on the ring finger of her left hand. It was something he had never seen before. In other words... was it the engagement ring that man gave her? !
His heart was struck by a furious storm, and he slapped the table hard. The momentum frightened everyone.
"Come here!" She couldn't help but freeze when she was shouted at by such an angry voice.
He pulled her out of her seat without waiting for her reaction, grabbed her hand, pulled off the ring, and smashed it angrily on Chen Qiming's body. He glared at him, and his sharp gaze sent chills down Chen Qiming's spine, and of course he didn't dare to stop him.
He dragged her out of the coffee shop and put her directly into the car.
Ye Yonghuan only came back to his senses at this time and tried to pull back his hand. "W-what are you doing? How could you do this? The ring that Boss Chen gave me..."
"Shut up! You are not allowed to say anything about the ring!"
How dare she accept another man's ring? ! She actually wants to marry another man? ! He broke into a cold sweat when he thought that if he didn't come today, this stupid woman might become someone else's the next day.
In addition to being annoyed that he was self-defeating, he was even more angry that she actually傻傻的就被别人牵着鼻子走。
No more, he felt that he had reached his limit, and he could not tolerate the slightest possibility of losing her.
Su Jincang crawled through his hair irritably, and he admitted that he had driven him.
"Stop making your own decisions and having random thoughts. Forget it, I'll marry you so that you and your son won't be separated. From now on, you can take care of your children at home."
Ye Yonghuan blinked in surprise, and then trembled slightly as if he suddenly realized the meaning of his words.
"No, don't...I definitely don't want to marry you."
Su Jincang's face turned completely dark.
她拒绝得那么快、没有犹豫。 How is she? Which middle-aged man who is almost balding would you rather choose than him?
这口气叫他怎么咽得下去？ !
"You, you, you..." He was almost furious, and he managed to burst out the final threat from his clenched teeth. "Anyway, I've decided. From now on, you and your son will move into my house!"
This is kidnapping!
Ye Yonghuan sat in the courtyard with a sad face, watching her son happily playing around. For little Tong, this is a great environment, with a complete set of swings, sandpits, and castles, all built by his father in three days.
He is very happy here. His mother stays with him all day long, he has his own toy room, and there is an outdoor playground covering an area of ​​dozens of square meters. But on the contrary, she couldn't be happy at all.
她没有办法跟他在一起。
She could never forget the charitable tone in which he proposed that she marry him.
Although he was angry when she rejected him, she thought it was because his pride was hurt, not because of her rejection. She couldn't tell him that the reason why she didn't want to marry him was not that she no longer loved him. On the contrary, she still loved him, cared about him very much, and cared that his every move affected all her emotions - this was exactly what she was afraid of.
She didn't want it anymore, no longer begging for his love like a beggar.
She had had enough, had enough of a marriage that seemed to be incompatible with each other.
The kind of pain that was right next to her, but she knew she would never get it... She had tasted enough, and had enough.
"Mama..." Xiao Tong, who was sweating profusely from playing, staggered to her side, hugged her legs, and interrupted her thoughts.
She wiped the sweat off him with a towel.
「把拔呢？把拔……」
Her son's innocent words gave her mixed feelings. It had only been a few days since he became extremely close to his father. She didn't know whether it was because of the nature of father and son or because their temperaments were really similar, but she could clearly see his shadow in her son.
When her son raised his face and asked her, "Where's the handle?" with the face she had been crazy about since she was a child, she really felt a deep sense of powerlessness...
"Baba is still at work."
Xiao Tong pursed his lips, seemingly dissatisfied with the answer.
Even the domineering expression was exactly the same, and she couldn't help but smile bitterly.
"Shall we go take a bath? After taking a bath and taking a nap, maybe the hair will come back." She had no choice but to comfort him.
"Okay!"
After getting her son's permission, she took him upstairs, took a bath for him, and washed herself at the same time. Then the two of them lay on the big bed in the master bedroom and fell asleep with the air conditioner blowing on.
This was what Su Jincang saw when he came home - his woman and his son sleeping sweetly. A warm feeling filled his chest, making his serious mouth soften a lot.
He felt complete, and the emptiness he had felt seemed to be filled.
She fell asleep with her child in her arms, and she fell asleep like a child. Her long eyelashes were like two thick fans, leaving two rows of shadows on her snow-white skin. Her bright lips were slightly open, and her bathrobe was slightly open because of her son, revealing her round curves.
Is it related to production? Her figure seemed plumper than he remembered.
His mouth suddenly went dry, and there was a familiar commotion in his lower abdomen. He found the sleepingShe was like a flower with a strong fragrance that seduced him.
He stretched out his fingertips to touch the pink lips that attracted him, and she shrank her shoulders in a ticklish manner. Her look was so cute that he wanted to hold her in his arms.
Ye Yonghuan opened her eyes and saw him. She suddenly realized that the distance between the two was very close. She stepped back, picked up her son, and got up from the bed.
"Yes, I'm sorry, I fell asleep on your bed. I just helped Xiao Tong take a bath. You know he likes the bathroom in your room..."
Her hurried explanation, her deliberate display of distance and politeness, made his chest feel hot and painful.
